audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ornn Level 2 and 2+ items and only 'Skill' at Levels 4-5 and 6, contradicting both the packet chart and the whys prose.
audit.why: whys[1] says concede and farm, whys[3]/[4]/[5] say Ornn punishes and wins outright, whys[6] says the duel evens out. The packet chart matches the prose exactly; the stored chart does not.
audit.corrected: Rows 1,3,4,6 realigned to Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Skill in both layers; Level 6 rating raised.

audit.why: Spikes read Volibear early, Ornn at 3, Ornn at 6, Ornn on first item — consistent with the 54.69% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly calls Sky Splitter (E) a stun ('E stun', 'hand-of-the-god stun') and describes Thundering Smash as a dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: Sky Splitter summons a lightning bolt that damages and slows, and shields Volibear if he is inside the blast — no stun anywhere. The only hard CC in the kit is Thundering Smash (Q), 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, which grants movement speed toward enemies and stuns the first one he attacks — it is an auto-attack reset, so the windup is the tell. Frenzied Maul (W) is 5s and heals on the second cast into the same target, and applies on-hit effects.
audit.corrected: Removed the invented E stun, named all five abilities, and put the stun where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the cooldown breakdown.
audit.why: Thundering Smash 12s, Frenzied Maul 5s, Sky Splitter a flat 16s, Stormbringer 160s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — His engage. Brittle-tank it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Thundering Smash (Q): 12s — the stun rides his next auto, so the windup is the tell, not the cast. - Frenzied Maul (W): 5s, heals on the second bite. - Sky Splitter (E): 16s slow and shield, no stun.

edits.before: Track Volibear's Thundering Smash (Stun): His engage. Brittle-tank it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Thundering Smash (Q), 12s: the stun lands on his next auto. Sky Splitter (E) only slows and shields.

edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s heal on its second bite — Grievous Wounds or don't extend.

edits.before: R's double knock-up interrupts his Q-dash engage and E stun before they land — you win the 6 all-in outright.
edits.after: R's knock-up beats his engage: Sky Splitter (E) only slows and shields him, so nothing answers you at 6.

edits.before: Land E hand-of-the-god stun to lock you while his Q-dash and bites burst you down
edits.after: Land Sky Splitter's slow so Thundering Smash catches you while Frenzied Maul bites

notes: The invented 'E stun' for Volibear appeared in whys[4], mid and wants.foe[2]; the two prose instances inside 'mid' and 'early' still describe a Q 'dash' (Riot's text says he gains move speed, not a dash) — those strings are long paragraphs where a targeted fix would break the length band, so they are flagged here rather than partially rewritten. On-hit note: Frenzied Maul applies on-hit and scales with his passive attack speed, so armour alone underrates his trade — worth surfacing in itemization on a later pass.
